name: pawzzles-content-engine
description: Lightweight local content generator for Pawzzles social posts.

scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const dirs=['output/briefs','output/captions','output/prompts','output/images','output/approved','output/rejected','output/scheduled']; for (const dir of dirs) { fs.mkdirSync(dir,{recursive:true}); for (const file of fs.readdirSync(dir)) fs.rmSync(path.join(dir,file),{recursive:true,force:true}); } for (const file of ['output/meta-schedule.csv','output/image-generation-queue.md']) fs.rmSync(file,{force:true}); console.log('Cleaned generated output.');"

author: Pawzzles
